heading: Availability to the public of flood-related data

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Administrator shall make flood-related data available to the public on the website of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration.

tree.heading: Cost
tree.text: The Administrator may make the data under subsection (a) freely accessible or available at a cost that does not exceed the cost of preparing the data.
